story.headline: Texas DPS fails to send counties voter registrations dating back to October 2025
story.summary: The Texas Department of Public Safety did not send county registrars voter registration applications and updates submitted through its online driver's license portal, Votebeat reported Sept. 22. Some records dated to October 2025, and DPS said a third-party vendor's software update cut off parts of them. By Sept. 24, seven counties had confirmed receiving more than 178,000 backlogged records, less than two weeks before the Oct. 5 registration deadline.

quote.text: DPS failed to send the applications, which were submitted by voters through its online driver’s license portal, to county voter registrars for processing, according to an email sent to county officials and provided to Votebeat.
